Module contents

A/B Testing Framework for Automated Model Adaptation SAC v421 Improvement Plan - Automated Model Adaptation

This module provides a comprehensive A/B testing framework designed for: - Statistical validation of model improvements - Memory-efficient streaming data processing - Parallel processing for performance optimization - Risk management with automatic rollback capabilities - Real-time traffic management and gradual deployment

Key Components: - types.py: Type definitions and data structures - config.py: Configuration management with performance optimizations - analyzer.py: Streaming statistical analysis engine - executor.py: Test execution engine with memory monitoring - selector.py: Model selection and rollback logic

Usage:

from ztb.adaptation.ab_test import ABTestExecutor, ABTestConfig

config = ABTestConfig() executor = ABTestExecutor(config) # Run A/B tests with automatic model selection
